skills.name: daily-journal
skills.description: Write a short dated journal entry from what the user tells you and save it as a note in an approved folder. Use when the user wants to journal, log their day or jot down a note for today.
skills.author: Piyo AI

skills.name: unit-converter
skills.description: Convert a number between units of length, mass, volume or temperature exactly, using a script instead of mental arithmetic. Use when the user asks to convert units, such as miles to kilometres, pounds to kilograms or Fahrenheit to Celsius.
skills.author: Piyo AI
